hinweis: Shown once per item on app start ("What's new"). Newest first. art: build | feature. vorschau: char, vault, armor, loadouts, optimizer, finder, wiki, guide, stats, zufall, build. ziel.tab opens a page, ziel.build opens that build in the Build Finder.

eintraege.text: Fireteam, Bungie friends, favorites, your own groups and regular teammates in one place – one-off LFG encounters stay hidden. Select people to compare or squad-check.
Two sliders under your profile → Look: scale the whole app or only the text.
Stats → Fireteam & compare checks every minute who is in your fireteam, shows a short card for everyone and compares you all automatically.
Choose maybe / always / never for primary and special weapons, plus a clear neutral mark on the luck lever.

eintraege.titel: Title & triumphs for every raid and dungeon
eintraege.text: Wiki → Raids & dungeons: everything a title needs, with your progress.
Charged Magnetic Grenades with Chaos Accelerant – big damage, damage resistance while charging, grenade energy back on hit.
Tracking Scatter Grenades everywhere, playable without any weapons.
